premises.text: Retail shippers of diverse real items face a hard, hidden packing-and-shipping cost problem: fragmented carriers will not quote unless items are boxed/crated/palletized, and buyers get few delivery options
premises.evidence_span: This problem is the cost of packing and shipping. Now, why is this such a problem? It's a problem because it's so hard to determine what it costs to pack and ship something

premises.text: ShipHawk aggregates fragmented shipping markets and converts real items into packed weights and dimensions to deliver instant multi-carrier packing and shipping quotes
premises.evidence_span: we're going to convert your real item into packed weights and dimensions. This allows us to provide customers with instant data, instant packing quotes, instant shipping quotes

premises.text: Users can schedule home/office pickup, drop off at a local ShipHawk network location, or get local delivery through the same system
premises.evidence_span: you get to schedule a pickup at your home or office. Or you can find a local ShipHawk network location where you can drop your item off

premises.text: ShipHawk monetizes by taking a commission from shipping, packing, insurance, and other service providers it sends business to
premises.evidence_span: ShipHawk makes money by collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to

domains.name: pickup dropoff and local delivery network

value.text: Shippers can move almost any item of any size/weight to almost any destination quickly and easily with comparable carrier options
value.evidence_span: help us make shipping easy for everyone

causal_links.evidence_span: ShipHawk solves a problem that people experience every day. It costs people real money and real time
you can ship almost any item of almost any size or weight to almost any destination from one website
You can overnight a letter or ship a tank from your living room in your slippers in less than three minutes
ShipHawk makes money by collecting a commission from all the service providers that we send business to

notes: Fragmentation, no-box quotes, and buyer option limits folded as one retail-shipping problem set (§4.1.6). Item-to-pack conversion and multi-carrier instant quotes folded as one Kayak-for-shipping mechanism (§4.1.7). Founder shipping-company biography excluded (§4.2.2). Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
